rationale: One off-route segment 12:46-13:07 via Paya Lebar Road and Sims Avenue adding 4.08 km (RD-1). No chat at all, so no prior agreement (RD-5 fails); no incident on the optimal route and both CTE and PIE were free-flowing at band 7, so no reasonable cause (RD-4 fails). Refund = 4.08 km x $1.41/km = $5.75 (RD-2); the meter excess (20.08 - 15.47 km) is explained by the segment plus the exit/rejoin stretches inside the 200 m band. Driver has 3 route disputes upheld in 90 d, so this upheld case makes the violation 'repeated': add flag_account (RD-6). Profile is only the basis for the flag, not for the finding.
